parentStream.description:
Reference to the "parent" {@link Data.FeatureSet.Stream}, which is responsible for implementing the
"macro-batch"ing.

title:
This specialization of {@link Data.Stream} contains the implementation details for the python versions of the streaming APIs
on {@link Data.FeatureSet#stream}.

NOTE: this stream is only implemented to be "in process", which means that passing this stream instance through
a C3 Action will not result in consistent behavior.

DEVELOPER NOTE: the python implementation is responsible for creating the {@link Data.StreamSpec#batchSize} - let's
call this the "micro-batch" size. It does this by calling the java implementation in {@link Data.FeatureSet.Stream}
to gather the data in the "macro-batch" size (i.e. storage block size) and iterating over that in-memory.
The in-memory "macro-batch" will be discarded when exhausted and the next one will be requested from the java implementation.

DEVELOPER NOTE: this python implementation tracks mutable state through the `$py_state` attribute, which is a
native python `dict` that holds and maintains state of the stream between `next` calls. This includes state such as:
- in-memory "macro-batch"(s)
- current position in "macro-batch"
